source.note: Official main commit 65c1722b (Prologue PR #141 on top of PR #140 ae163997): policy monotonicity at EffectChain.prepare (strict monotonic restrict merge respecting posture.approval === 'never', unforgeable WeakSet handoff only for explicit outer owner-gated tool ask on default-deny path/command), destructive command guard hardening (Windows drive-root deletion plus dd and shutdown), NodeHost public storage Proxy allow-list narrowing (has/get restricted to PUBLIC_STORAGE_METHODS, blocking internal fields/methods), and 0.1.0-rc.3 release bump. No vendor patch.

steps: Extract two independent clean archives from official main commit 65c1722b14f9c0b18599d2614ddf48e654ae3af0 (Prologue PR #141) via git archive.
Run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline --ignore-scripts, pnpm build, and pnpm -C packages/sdk pack in both clean archives using Node 24.14.0 and pnpm 11.9.0.
Confirm both produced prologue-sdk-0.1.0-rc.3.tgz tarballs are byte-identical via cmp -s and record exact bytes, SHA-256, and SHA-512 integrity.
build.note: Official 0.1.0-rc.3 package incorporating Prologue PR #141 policy monotonicity, destructive command guard, and NodeHost storage proxy hardening.
